children: Selected Pendle yield markets for SHROOM and microduck begin trading on Robinhood Crypto on 24 Sep 2026, extending Pendle's fee-stream products into the Robinhood app for its retail user base.

This is the first time Pendle's fee-stream markets are available through a large retail venue, which broadens distribution beyond crypto-native platforms. Access through Robinhood can raise trading activity in these yield markets, and protocol fees accrue to Pendle as volume grows. The listing covers only selected markets for two Pons assets, so the initial scope is narrow and wider adoption depends on additional markets being added. PENDLE holders may watch fee revenue and distribution growth from the partnership.
Pons assets are now live on Pendle, with selected markets with 24 Sep 2026 to start on
